share.title: Share page
share.intro: Publish this page at a link. Republishing keeps the same link.
share.notPublished: This page is not published yet.

accessHint.private: Only you can open the link.
accessHint.tenant: Members of your organization must sign in to open it.
accessHint.link: Anyone with the link can open it without signing in.

share.passwordSet: A password protects this link. Type a new one to replace it.
share.customDateInvalid: Pick a date in the future, at most 365 days from today.
share.neverNote: This link never expires and remains active until unpublished.
share.autoPublishHint: When off, edits stay unpublished until you publish them.
share.unpublishConfirm: Unpublish? The link stops working and the page's saved data is deleted. Comments are kept.
share.loadError: Could not load the sharing settings. Try again.

view.notFoundBody: This link does not exist, was unpublished, or is not shared with you.
view.expiredBody: This page stopped being shared on {date}. Ask the owner for a new link.
view.expiredBodyNoDate: This page is no longer shared. Ask the owner for a new link.
view.signInBody: This page is shared with members of an organization. Sign in to open it.
view.passwordBody: Enter the password the owner gave you.
view.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
view.errorBody: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

storage.confirmBody: This page wants to save data that everyone who opens it can see. Only allow this if you trust the page.

comments.title: Comments
comments.readOnly: You can view comments but not post them.

wake.started: The agent is working on a reply.
wake.unavailable: The agent is not available right now. Your comment was saved.
wake.busy: The agent is already replying in this thread.
wake.limited: The agent has reached its hourly limit. Try again later.

comments.draftReady: The agent prepared a draft of the page.
comments.forbidden: You do not have permission to comment on this page.

library.intro: Pages you published, and pages your organization shared with you.
library.emptyBody: Open a web page in chat and press Share to publish it.
library.unpublishConfirm: Unpublish this page? Its link stops working right away; the page stays here until you delete it.
library.unpublishedNotice: Page unpublished. Its link no longer works.
library.deleteConfirm: Move this page to the recycle bin? Its link stops working; you can restore it for 30 days, and it comes back unpublished.
library.deletedNotice: Page moved to the recycle bin
library.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
